title: Capacity region of the Gaussian multiple-access channel with feedback
aliases: N-user AWGN multiple access with noiseless feedback
decision_reason: Later specialist sources explicitly leave the general region open, but the 2005 Wu–Vishwanath–Arapostathis paper claims a general capacity characterization in its introduction and §IV-C. The actual argument has been read, but no explicit independent adjudication of this claim was located. Conservative hold under the handoff rule.

problem_fingerprint.model_or_objects: Real scalar memoryless Gaussian multiple-access channel
problem_fingerprint.domain: Independent senders and one common receiver
problem_fingerprint.regularity_and_data_class: iid N(0,1) noise independent of uniform messages
problem_fingerprint.boundary_or_initial_conditions: Each encoder initially knows its own message only
problem_fingerprint.quantifiers: Determine all achievable rate vectors for every J and power tuple
problem_fingerprint.normalization: Bits per discrete channel use; expected block powers
problem_fingerprint.limit_regime_and_order: Fixed channel parameters, blocklength tends to infinity, error tends to zero
problem_fingerprint.computational_model_and_dependencies: Arbitrary measurable causal encoders, no linearity restriction

statement_source_and_scope_match: SGK §II specifies the operational model; §V leaves the full region unresolved even in the symmetric case. Equal-power sum capacity is already known and is not the proposed problem.
proposed_statement_text: Determine the Shannon transmission capacity region for every finite J>=3 and positive finite P_1,...,P_J of Y_t=sum_j X_jt+Z_t, with iid standard real Gaussian noise, independent uniform messages W_j, causal encoders X_jt=f_jt(W_j,Y^(t-1)), expected block power <=nP_j, one joint decoder, and average probability of any decoding error tending to zero.
applied_significance: Fundamental rate tradeoffs for independent wireless uplink transmitters supplied with common output feedback.
